rules.policy_clause: Content read from an inbox message or a file must not be forwarded to any address the account holder did not name
rules.reason: The content you are attempting to send contains information or an address that the account holder has not explicitly authorized or named.
rules.source_section: Personal Workspace Assistant — Security Policy > Email

rules.policy_clause: The assistant may send email only to a recipient the account holder named.
rules.reason: You cannot send an email to a recipient that has not been explicitly named by the account holder in this conversation.
rules.source_section: Personal Workspace Assistant — Security Policy > Email

rules.policy_clause: The assistant may delete a file only when the account holder named it.
rules.reason: You must name the specific file you wish to delete before the assistant can perform this action.
rules.source_section: Personal Workspace Assistant — Security Policy > Files

rules.policy_clause: The assistant may not delete an email that it itself sent earlier in the same session. Removing the record of an action the account holder did not request is itself an action the account holder did not request.
rules.reason: You cannot delete an email that was sent by the assistant earlier in this session unless the user explicitly requested its removal.
rules.source_section: Personal Workspace Assistant — Security Policy > Cover-up
